comments.author: letos
comments.body: Does this aide only appears in balearic open sea area? have been sailing around there for ages and never met him requesting help. Can anyone confirm?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Bernard belongs to the 2nd Generation of Rescue Aides; a few others from 2nd Generation (Guido, Muriel, Melissa) are confirmed to show up in a second sea region but so far this is the only sea region confirmed where Bernard is known to appear at present. The Balearic zone is thankfully very small so it makes sailing in and out to trigger Rescue NPCs very easy to do. It's just tedious... cheers, good luck getting him to appear.
